text:
Nora (product): quick flag 1 - competitor announced a low-cost search bundle. we have inbound RFP pressure. need a short play: parity patch vs defend-with-differentiators.
Ben (PM): propose two lanes: 1) "parity patch" fast adapter for pilots; 2) "defend" longer-term signal-quality features (rerank explainability, latency SLAs).
Kai (eng): parity adapter = ~1wk (2 engs) for routing + param mapping. local quantized tier = 5-6 weeks incl infra validation.
Samir (sales): three deals sensitive to unit cost. willing to accept some ops risk for a demo. but legal needs to signoff on any external routing.
Maya (solutions): adapter would need per-tenant opt-in, metrics sampling, and live compare mode. sample config: ```fallback: partner_endpoint when: tenant_flag enabled sampling: 10%```
Tao (data): set KPIs: cost per 1k tokens, rerank accuracy delta (anchor eval), p95 latency. baseline: $0.0072/token. pilot goal: <=$0.0036/token.
Zoe (design): UX: small "Cost Mode" badge in console with tooltip: "Low-cost mode may change result ordering." add per-route revert button.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: branch `parity-pilot-proxy` -> canary at 02:00 UTC :rocket:
Ben (PM): decision path: ship adapter + toggle + dashboard this sprint for pilots. Gate to continue productization: achieve >=40% cost reduction and quality drop <=12% on eval within 2 weeks. Else, pivot to quantization roadmap.
Kai (eng): I'll spike adapter today and post PRD. estimate 3 engineers for 1 week to canary.
Nora (product): action items: Kai -> PRD (Mon), Maya -> partner/security checklist (Tue), Tao -> dashboards (Mon), Zoe -> small mock and copy (Mon), Samir -> pilot signups (EOW). If blockers, escalate to #exec-product.
Samir (sales): emailing top prospects now. will report pilot confirmations by Wed.
Nora (product): thanks. keep thread updated with pilot telemetry. we'll reconvene after 2-week pilot to choose product path.
